description: [WRITE] Combine (merge) another container into this one. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true. ⚠️  This merges the source container identified by containerIdToCombine into the target container.

allowUserPermissionFeatureUpdate.description: Allow updating the user-permission feature during combine.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The target container ID (the surviving container).

containerIdToCombine.description: The container ID to merge into the target.

name: containers_combine
